The BCRP's annual statistics put 2023 agricultural non-traditional exports at about US$ 9,169 million FOB, up from US$ 8,368 million in 2022 ([BCRP BCRPData, annual series](https://estadisticas.bcrp.gob.pe/estadisticas/series/anuales/resultados/PM40121BA/html)). The same table lists 2024 at US$ 11,096 million.

For the total non-traditional category, the BCRP's February 2024 note reports US$ 18,424 million for 2023, a 1.1% rise, which it attributes mainly to higher agricultural prices (up 11%) ([BCRP nota informativa, 14 Feb 2024](https://www.bcrp.gob.pe/docs/Transparencia/Notas-Informativas/2024/nota-informativa-2024-02-14.pdf)).

I did not find a dedicated weekly ("Nota semanal") publication with the full-year 2023 agricultural figure. The search returned monthly-style BCRP notes, such as the one for February 2023, which reported US$ 756 million in agricultural non-traditional exports for that month, up 18.8% ([BCRP nota informativa, 17 Apr 2023](https://www.bcrp.gob.pe/docs/Transparencia/Notas-Informativas/2023/nota-informativa-2023-04-17.pdf)). Those notes are a useful cross-check if you need the monthly breakdown.
